status: all ten ARFs completed and passed their frozen response gate; before any source-energy fit, the weighted RATE NXB constraints were refrozen to use optimal grouping with a minimum signal-to-noise of 3 on the full response grid, while source COUNTS remain ungrouped and use C-stat; no source model, fit band, gravity parameter, validation target, or holdout target changed
purpose: Reproduce the seven published A2319 detector-region velocities on the three strictly bracketed commissioning fragments using current official response and NXB tools, then decide whether the signed ICM velocity field is sufficiently identified to become a development-only Sigma source diagnostic.

closed_failure_history.completed: all three exact branch/environment GTI intersections and all seven detector-region files
closed_failure_history.failed_at: runtime hygiene audit of the captured maketime stderr before spectrum or response generation
closed_failure_history.root_cause: PFILES used a colon between the writable user directory and read-only system directory; HEASoft requires a semicolon for that boundary
closed_failure_history.correction: replace only the separator, rerun from an empty response-product root, and require punlearn stderr to be clean

pre_response_interface_amendment.discovered_by: installed HEASoft 6.36 rslmkrmf.par and xaarfgen.html audit after the Chandra image gate and before any XRISM response or spectrum generation
pre_response_interface_amendment.problem: rslmkrmf exposes a hidden time parameter whose static default is 2019-01-01T00:00:00; leaving it implicit would make CALDB response selection depend on an unrelated software default
pre_response_interface_amendment.correction: set rslmkrmf time to the DATE-OBS string already recorded in each corrected branch event header; record every transitive executable invoked internally by xaarfgen

pre_nxb_interface_amendment.discovered_by: fail-closed installed-tool probes before the first NXB or RMF product
corrections: pass the exact final GTI to xaexpmap as corrected_branch.evt[GTI] because the tool requires an event-like file contract
materialize each Hp selection and run extractor with ccol=NONE because PIXEL would incorrectly request multiple GTI indexing
pass the 300-day NXB window as timefirst=-300 and timelast=+300 because unsigned integers enter rslnxbgen's calendar-string branch
pass the already-frozen detector-region file to rslnxbgen because the installed wrapper's condition reads pixels only when regfile is not NONE; redundantly pass the exact pixel list

pre_fit_statistical_amendment.discovered_by: inspection of the completed source and rslnxbgen PHA headers before ARF generation or any XSPEC source-energy fit
pre_fit_statistical_amendment.correction: fit source and NXB as separate simultaneous data groups with separate responses and statistics; retain the empirical NXB model and constrain it with the generated RATE spectrum rather than treating that spectrum as Poisson counts or subtracting it

pre_fit_grouping_amendment.discovered_by: fail-closed inspection of all ten completed weighted RATE NXB spectra after ARF generation and before any XSPEC source-energy fit
pre_fit_grouping_amendment.problem: the ungrouped weighted NXB RATE spectra contain channels with zero supplied statistical error, so standard chi-square cannot be applied channel by channel; a grouping rule must be fixed without consulting source line centroids or velocities
pre_fit_grouping_amendment.correction: run ftgrouppha with grouptype=optsnmin and groupscale=3.0 over the full 60000-channel response grid; keep source COUNTS ungrouped; temporarily expose the NXB product as HDUCLAS2=BKG only for ftgrouppha compatibility, restore HDUCLAS2=DERIVED afterward, and set RESPFILE=NONE because the XSPEC deck assigns the frozen diagonal response explicitly

gti_protocol.step_1: Intersect every parent GTI row with the closed branch interval and discard zero-width intersections.
gti_protocol.step_2: Construct the observation source-environment GTI from the EHK expression T_SAA_SXS>0 && DYE_ELV>5 && CORTIME>6.
gti_protocol.step_3: Intersect steps 1 and 2 and use that exact final GTI for the event file, source spectrum, grade-weight event, rslnxbgen input, and xaexpmap.
conditional_header_updates: Update LIVETIME using the preserved DEADC only when both keywords already exist; do not invent missing dead-time metadata.
gti_protocol.forbidden: Do not use the copied broad parent GTI or infer exposure from the first and last event times.

event_selections.spectrum_energy_filter: none during extraction; ignore outside the frozen fit band in XSPEC

nxb_protocol.regfile: exact frozen detector-region DS9 file, with the exact pixel list passed redundantly because the installed 2025 rslnxbgen wrapper reads pixels only when regfile is not NONE
nxb_protocol.fit_treatment: simultaneous source and NXB data groups: ungrouped source COUNTS use C-stat through the regional RMF and ARF; optimally grouped NXB RATE with supplied STAT_ERR uses standard chi-square through the diagonal response and no ARF; the grouping is fixed at optsnmin 3 on the full response grid, the empirical NXB model is first constrained over 1-17 keV, then its recommended normalization parameters remain free while its other parameters are frozen
nxb_protocol.public_db_limitation: The public provisional database spans 2023-12-25 through 2024-05-24 and is not proven byte-identical to the collaboration-internal NXB v2 used in the paper.

rmf_protocol.pixlist: comma-separated runs using hyphens, never colons
rmf_protocol.caldb_time: exact DATE-OBS string from the branch corrected event header, passed explicitly to rslmkrmf time

xaarfgen.xrtevtfile: one branch-specific raytrace file created internally when absent and reused only across detector regions of that same branch

attitude_and_arf_protocol.detector_region_representation: one DS9 physical box of width and height 1 centered on each selected integer DETX,DETY pixel; validate the selected PIXEL set against the branch event before raytracing
attitude_and_arf_protocol.raytrace_reuse: A branch-specific IMAGE raytrace may be reused for all detector regions of that branch only when the exact Chandra image, exposure map, energy range, source coordinates, photon count, and seed match.

chandra_image_protocol.merge_method: CIAO merge_obs exposure-corrected broad-band image on the native 0.492 arcsec sky grid
chandra_image_protocol.pixel_policy: replace non-finite and negative values with zero; retain positive surface-brightness pixels without background subtraction or smoothing
chandra_image_protocol.acceptance: celestial WCS present, both ObsIDs contribute positive exposure, dimensions cover exactly the frozen crop to pixel-rounding tolerance, and at least one positive finite source pixel

fit_protocol.primary_model: tbabs*bapec plus the separately responded additive empirical NXB model
fit_protocol.statistic: mixed simultaneous likelihood; no background subtraction
fit_protocol.data_group_protocol: For every branch-region product, load ungrouped source COUNTS and the optsnmin-3 grouped NXB RATE as separate data groups. Apply the regional RMF and ARF only to the source plasma channel; apply the frozen diagonal response and no ARF to the empirical NXB channel in both groups.
fit_protocol.nxb_prefit_sequence: Without consulting source line centroids or velocities, optimally group the weighted NXB RATE spectrum to minimum signal-to-noise 3 over the full 60000-channel response grid, then fit the public 56-parameter empirical NXB model over 1-17 keV with standard chi-square, starting from the delivered state. Freeze all parameters except the model's recommended normalization parameters before the source fit; retain those normalizations as nuisance parameters.
fit_protocol.pointing_linkage: Tie kT, abundance, redshift, and velocity dispersion for the same P1 detector region across its two branches; keep branch source normalizations and NXB normalizations separate. P2 contains only 000102000 because 000103000 has no strictly bracketed gain interval.
fit_protocol.reported_velocity_formula: c*(z_fit-z_BCG)/(1+z_BCG) - 12.42 km/s; also report fitted redshift so comparison does not depend on this convention
fit_protocol.uncertainty: one-parameter delta-C=1 profile interval for redshift/velocity; record covariance and optimizer bounds

robustness_models.name: two_temperature_shared_velocity
robustness_models.linkage: two temperatures and normalizations; shared abundance, redshift, and velocity dispersion within detector region

published_no_ssm_benchmark.claim: diagnostic comparator rather than sealed validation truth because the paper combines 000102000 and excluded 000103000 and used HEASoft 6.34/XSPEC 12.12.0

terminal_gate.robust_velocity_rule: A region is robust when narrow-band and two-temperature velocities each lie within 150 km/s or the combined 2-sigma interval of the primary velocity.
required_reports_even_on_failure: all failed commands or fit gates
terminal_gate.decision: Only a pass authorizes constructing the signed A2319 gas-current development source. It does not validate Sigma gravity and does not authorize A3667 or A754 access.

claim_boundary: This is a development-only response and identifiability test for one time-odd baryonic observable, not a gravity-theory score.
The public NXB database, missing 000103 bracketed exposure, newer software/calibration, and absence of the paper's full five-by-seven SSM model limit exact reproduction.
No validation or holdout cluster, lensing target, halo target, gravity parameter, or action candidate may be opened or changed in this stage.
